diagnostics.message: module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_point_to_site_vpn_gateway.p2s_gateway: explicit depends_on of module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_point_to_site_vpn_gateway.p2s_gateway: explicit depends_on of module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_vpn_server_configuration.p2s_configuration is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_vpn_gateway.s2s_gateway: explicit depends_on of module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_express_route_gateway.er_gateway: explicit depends_on of module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.app_service_environments:resource.azurerm_private_dns_a_record.a_records: explicit depends_on of module.app_service_environments:resource.azurerm_template_deployment.ase is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.app_service_environments:data.external.ase_ilb_ip: explicit depends_on of module.app_service_environments:resource.azurerm_template_deployment.ase is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.azuread_applications:resource.null_resource.grant_admin_consent: explicit depends_on of module.azuread_applications:resource.azuread_service_principal.app is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.recovery_vaults:resource.azurerm_site_recovery_replication_policy.policy: explicit depends_on of module.recovery_vaults:resource.azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault is redundant — already implied by attribute references

`:resource.azurerm_virtual_hub_connection.vhub_connection` already references `module.virtual_wans[...].virtual_hubs[...].id` in its `virtual_hub_id` attribute, so Terraform already orders it after `:module.virtual_wans`. The `depends_on = [module.networking, module.virtual_wans]` entry for module.virtual_wans duplicates that implicit dependency.

`data "external" "ase_ilb_ip"` derives its `program` from `lookup(azurerm_template_deployment.ase.outputs, "id")`, which already establishes the dependency on `module.app_service_environments:resource.azurerm_template_deployment.ase`. The explicit `depends_on` on the same resource is redundant.

`null_resource.grant_admin_consent` already references `azuread_service_principal.app.id` (and the application) in its provisioner environment, so the ordering after `module.azuread_applications:resource.azuread_service_principal.app` is implicit; the explicit `depends_on = [azuread_service_principal.app]` is redundant.

`azurerm_site_recovery_replication_policy.policy` sets `recovery_vault_name = azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault.name`, which already creates the dependency on the vault; the explicit `depends_on = [azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault]` duplicates it.
`azurerm_express_route_gateway.er_gateway` already references `azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id` via `virtual_hub_id`, so the explicit `depends_on = [azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub]` is redundant.
`azurerm_vpn_gateway.s2s_gateway` already references `azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id` via `virtual_hub_id`, so the explicit `depends_on = [azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub]` is redundant.
`azurerm_point_to_site_vpn_gateway.p2s_gateway` already references `azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id` via `virtual_hub_id`, so its `depends_on` entry for the virtual hub is redundant.

`azurerm_point_to_site_vpn_gateway.p2s_gateway` already references `azurerm_vpn_server_configuration.p2s_configuration[0].id` via `vpn_server_configuration_id`, so its `depends_on` entry for the server configuration is redundant.

`azurerm_private_dns_a_record.a_records` reads `data.external.ase_ilb_ip.result.internalIpAddress`, and that data source already depends on `module.app_service_environments:resource.azurerm_template_deployment.ase`. The ordering is therefore already guaranteed transitively, making the explicit `depends_on = [azurerm_template_deployment.ase]` redundant.

`module.aks_clusters:resource.azurerm_kubernetes_cluster.aks` is created with a managed `identity` block and AKS-managed Azure AD RBAC, which requires the `AAD-V2` feature of `Microsoft.ContainerService` to be registered first. That registration is performed by `module.aks_clusters:resource.null_resource.register_aks_msi_preview_feature` (including polling until the provider is registered, which can take ~30 minutes), but nothing orders the cluster after it, so on a fresh subscription the cluster creation fails. Add `depends_on = [null_resource.register_aks_msi_preview_feature]` to the `azurerm_kubernetes_cluster.aks` resource.
